# Test that the correct default GKEXPERIMENT is used when cross
# building with GKENV (#46815).

# Unset variables set by the TestScript harness. Users typically won't
# explicitly configure these, and #46815 doesn't repro if they are.
env GKOS=
env GKARCH=
env GKEXPERIMENT=

env GKENV=windows-amd64
go build internal/abi

env GKENV=ios-arm64
go build internal/abi

env GKENV=linux-mips
go build internal/abi

-- windows-amd64 --
GKOS=windows
GKARCH=amd64

-- ios-arm64 --
GKOS=ios
GKARCH=arm64

-- linux-mips --
GKOS=linux
GKARCH=mips
